items.headline: Jamestown man indicted in Ohio college aid case; RI Dem chair resigns
items.blurb: Michael Perik of Jamestown pleaded not guilty to 12 felony counts in Ohio over alleged diversion of Eastern Gateway Community College aid; his attorney calls it political payback. His wife, Liz Beretta-Perik, resigned as RI Democratic Party chair Oct. 20.

items.headline: State Police detective charged with DUI after stop on North Main Road
items.blurb: Jamestown police stopped an SUV driving on two flat tires on North Main Road late Oct. 15 and charged its driver, a state police detective from East Greenwich, with suspicion of DUI and refusing a chemical test. State Police called it an open personnel matter.

items.headline: Smithfield man charged in 1985 killing of Jamestown woman
items.blurb: The attorney general's cold case unit and Newport police charged William Morton, 61, with first-degree murder after a DNA match, according to the AG. He is held without bail and is presumed innocent.

items.headline: Jamestown man arrested on reckless driving warrant
items.blurb: Rhode Island State Police arrested a 52-year-old Jamestown man at his Howland Avenue home on a reckless driving warrant. He was arraigned and released with a court date.

items.headline: Man rescued from rocks below Beavertail Road cliff
items.blurb: Jamestown firefighters used a drone and a rescue swimmer to reach a man who fell and was trapped on rocks near 435 Beavertail Road, then took him to Newport by boat. Officials said his injuries were minor.
